active_plan_transition.reason: Journey active plan equals the accepted proposal plan.

outcome.user_summary: The approved pending Agent action resumed and executed.

agent_run_terminal.reason: AgentRun completed with a server-owned mutation outcome.

approval_ordering.reason: Approval timestamps are monotonic and the receipt is CONSUMED.

authenticated_approver.reason: Approval is tied to a member identity that passed the authenticated in-force route boundary at approval time.

authenticated_collective_responses.reason: Every required member response has an authenticated traveler audit.

c4_protected_commitments.reason: Active C4 commitments remain anchored on the active plan.

durable_continuation.reason: The same AgentRun owns a durable pending action that reached RESUMED.

execution_truth.reason: All execution-state transitions carry explicit truth labels.

non_selected_proposals_rejected.reason: Every non-selected collective proposal is terminally non-active.

proposal_accept_request.reason: The resumed AgentRun request id is the exact request recorded by the acceptance audit.

real_external_agent_runtime.reason: Runtime identifiers do not match local/deterministic controls.

same_run_resume_step.reason: Original gated call and approved mutation are steps on the same AgentRun.

selected_proposal_accepted.reason: The approval target is the accepted ReplanProposal.

transport_caller_principal_authenticatio.reason: Both collective responses and the approval are machine-bound to authenticated traveler principals.
